extraction.Name: Cecelia Ferron (Longcor)
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded October 8, 1918 by the First National Bank of Valentine
extraction.Buyer: Cecelia Ferron Longcor and Fred Longcor conveyed the land to John Brinda on September 4, 1923 for $8500
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612689 issued; the west half, and the west half of the southeast quarter of Section 29, township 37, range 28; receipt for patent signed by allottee February 18, 1918. Document also contains a second allottee: Morris Joseph Donville (Douville), Allotment No. 1168, southeast quarter of section 26, township 36, range 31, fee patent No. 612677 issued December 29, 1917, receipt signed January 12, 1918, patent recorded March 5, 1918 by R. E. Wang, land mortgaged March 1, 1918 by Douville and wife for $600.00, then conveyed by deed to G. B. Roberts for $1.00 and other valuable consideration by Douville and his wife on April 20, 1918.
